WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT 
    p.product_id,
    pc.product_type_description,
    AVG(CAST(oi.product_quantity AS REAL)) as col3,
    COUNT(oi.order_item_id) as col4
  FROM Products p
  LEFT JOIN Order_Items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  JOIN Product_Categories pc ON p.production_type_code = pc.production_type_code
  GROUP BY p.product_id, pc.product_type_description
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT SUM(col4) as col1
  FROM step1
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT 
    s1.product_id,
    s1.product_type_description,
    s1.col3,
    s1.col4,
    CAST(s1.col4 AS REAL) / s2.col1 as col5
  FROM step1 s1
  CROSS JOIN step2 s2
  WHERE s2.col1 IS NOT NULL
),
step4 AS (
  SELECT 
    product_type_description,
    AVG(col3) as col2,
    AVG(col4) as col3,
    AVG(col5) as col4
  FROM step3
  GROUP BY product_type_description
)
SELECT 
  AVG(col2) as result1,
  AVG(col3) as result2,
  AVG(col4) as result3
FROM step4
